success_scope: 현행 native 기하+body 하중+오압현 판정이며, 보정된 현 압력이나 음향 측정이 아님
requested_nonassigned_target_policy: bounded current targets; actual joints may move under physics

patch_sample_index_contract.selected_patch_sample: GPU original pad sample axis index (all source samples)
patch_sample_index_contract.chosen_selected_sample: index within valid source pad subset; used by local FK Jacobian only; not interchangeable

feedback_contract.scope: 압현 램프 종료 후 국소 패드 추종; candidate가 없어도2.5초부터 작동하며 첫 접촉 개선은 미검증
feedback_contract.wrong_behavior: hold previous bounded request, no extra pressing

unloaded_bias.body_load: native distal body net contact flag; not calibrated string pressure or guaranteed guitar contact
unloaded_bias.scope: 무하중/목표근처/정상방향/오압현없음일 때 고정 기하 시도; 하중 획득 보장 아님

chosen_candidate.contact_margin_scope: one best eligible sample; normalized minimum includes facing; geometric only
chosen_candidate.joint_margin_scope: native requested angle range; 0 at limit and1 at midpoint, not anatomical certification
chosen_candidate.collision_limitation: finger/body and finger/finger shape collision not tested by this candidate search

trace_summary.scope: 60Hz endpoint samples; episode note ledger supplies native 240Hz clean streak/hold criterion. Nonassigned requested targets are held, actual joints remain physical.

substep240_summary.scope: Independent actual-substep diagnostic; unchanged native episode note ledger remains the success authority
